eng3.selected_route: Pinned ENG3 handler-table index 3 (0x22e40) -> 0x24770 projection/depth gate -> 0x8da0 shared renderer -> conditional 0x231a0 FT4 producer at 0x901d; handler index 1 reaches alternate 2D writer 0x90e0.
eng3.source_records: 0x231a0 prepares three local signed-WORD XYZ triplets, each passed by pointer through slot 102/B430; it prepares a fourth three-WORD triplet for slot 101/B6F0. The callback boundary proves the 3x signed-WORD layout; object/resource units and object identity remain unresolved. The separate 0x24770 helper reads three object DWORD fields, arithmetic-shifts each right 16, and narrows the result to WORDs before slot 101.
eng3.setup: 0x231a0 passes global pointer 0x100394b8 through slot 108/B880, which loads nine WORD coefficients into A8E75c..A8E76c. It then sends A8E71c/28/34 through slot 111/B2F0 to current context+0x78 and passes context+0x78 through slot 110/B8C0, which loads four translation DWORDs into A8E770..A8E77c; the fourth source DWORD is not written by B2F0 in this sequence. Center/focal writes via 174/175 are present elsewhere, not in 0x231a0.
eng3.projection_and_packet: slot 102/B430 loads three signed-WORD XYZ triplets into host input scratch; slot 107/B320 transforms input triplet i into camera/screen lane i; slot 117/B5C0 pairs lane i to FT4 packet vertex i at offsets +08/+0a, +10/+12, +18/+1a. The fourth triplet uses slots 101/B6F0 -> 106/B920 -> 114/B720, with B720 writing to packet+0x20. The cursor is 0x10043164; producer stride is 0x28; it links through an OT-head pointer derived from current view 0x10041448.
eng3.visibility: Handler 0x22e40 has a parent 0x24a80 reject path that sets object byte +0x1f bit 0x08. Per child, 0x24770 returns true only when the slot-121/B870 output word (camera Z arithmetic-shifted right 2) is greater than 0x40; only then does the path call 0xa410 and 0x8da0. 0x231a0 itself has additional flag/state gates. No claim that this is the only ENG3 cull/clip path.
eng3.alternate_2d: Pinned ENG3 handler-table index 1 reaches 0x90e0, whose only direct call is local command/color helper 0x23b00; it writes FT4 coordinates from existing WORD fields/resource deltas without slots 101/106/114.

title.selected_route: Pinned TITLE mode table index 5 -> 0x181e0 FT4 producer; index 6 -> 0x03d10 direct-writer dispatcher, including the bounded 0x03420 2D route.
title.source_records: 0x181e0 assembles three local signed-WORD XYZ triplets from object/resource fields and passes their pointers through slot 102/B430; its fourth triplet goes through slot 101/B6F0. The callback boundary proves the 3x signed-WORD layout; object identity and coordinate unit are not inferred.
title.setup: The selected writer conditionally calls 0x196f0 when 0x1002d328 is nonzero. Its 0xCA40 and 0xCA60 helpers are copied-table wrappers to slot 164 at HERC RVA 0xBB00 and slot 165 at 0xBC30; the former reads the 4096-WORD lookup table reached through HERC table cell 5 (RVA 0x37480), and the latter combines the local values with the pinned TITLE matrix at RVA 0x260E0. The result is passed through slot 108/B880 at 0xC7D0. The writer then tail-calls 0xC790, which is slot 103/B840: B840 copies current camera XYZ dwords into host translation cells. The selected callback and data dependencies are byte-pinned, but the source/meaning of the computed matrix and coordinate units remain unresolved. Slots 174/175 exist in TITLE wrappers at 0xCB10/0xCB30 but are not called by 0x181e0 itself.
title.projection_and_packet: The selected producer uses slots 102/B430 -> 107/B320 -> 117/B5C0 for its first three signed-WORD XYZ triplets, then 101/B6F0 -> 106/B920 -> 114/B720 for its fourth. B5C0 pairs each transformed input lane to the matching FT4 packet vertex slot. Packet cursor is 0x1002df40, stride 0x28; order head derives from the current view at 0x1002cc04. Object identity and coordinate units remain unresolved.
title.visibility_and_clip: The selected writer has a conditional matrix setup through 0x196f0, then copies current camera XYZ into translation via slot 103/B840. The bounded mode-5 producer does not call slot 104/B4B0. A separate TITLE mode-3 path calls 0x19470 on a child and accepts it only when camera Z>>2 > 0x40, then passes the same child pointer to dynamic mode dispatch. The 0x19470 output at child+0..+4 is a projection/depth gate; selected mode-5 packet construction consumes separately derived local geometry.
title.alternate_2d: Mode 6 dispatch 0x03d10 selects among direct FT4 writers including 0x03420; that writer's only direct call is 0x189a0 and it writes 0x28-stride packets without 101/106/114 geometry calls. Its source positions are signed WORD fields at object+0x0c/+0x0e plus resource byte deltas.

cross_module_readiness.ENG1: Separate prior STATIC_OBSERVED baseline: reviewed point emitters at 0x2e600/0x2e6c0/0x2ed10 call slot 101/B6F0 -> 106/B920 -> 114/B720; this report only hash-checks ENG1 and cites its existing evidence, without transferring ENG1 producer or culling conclusions to ENG3/TITLE.
cross_module_readiness.ENG3: The bounded 3D FT4 route associates the global nine-WORD matrix, three signed-WORD XYZ triplets, output camera/screen lanes, fourth one-triplet projection, and 0x28-byte packet destination through copied-table callbacks. Each B320 input triplet maps through B5C0 to the corresponding packet vertex. The fourth translation dword remains unresolved.
cross_module_readiness.TITLE: Mode-5 3D FT4 route and mode-6 direct 2D route are statically established. The mode-5 writer conditionally seeds its matrix through a closed slot164/slot165 callback and lookup-table path, loads it via slot108/B880, then copies camera XYZ through slot103/B840. Its triplet-to-output-lane-to-packet-vertex association matches ENG3, while projection center/focal setup remains external to the selected writer.
cross_module_readiness.common_reusable_facts: Host callbacks B6F0/B920/B720 implement a signed WORD triplet input, matrix transform, perspective projection, and caller XY output. Camera Z is clamped to at least 1 in B740; B870 exposes Z>>2 as a WORD. This does not establish identical per-module source records or all producer routes.

eng1_baseline.comparison_limit: The pre-existing ENG1 trace is a separate baseline. This audit does not infer ENG3 or TITLE source records, culling, or alternate producers from ENG1.

transform_precision.slot_106_B740_single_point: The three signed-product terms accumulate with low-32-bit register wrap; the row sum is arithmetic-shifted right 12, translation is added, and the low WORD is sign-extended to a DWORD. The Z result is clamped to at least 1. This describes B740 only.
transform_precision.slot_107_B320_batch: Separately, each batch row accumulates signed products in 32-bit registers, arithmetic-shifts the row sum right 12, adds its translation DWORD, then sign-extends the low WORD into the camera DWORD lane. No minimum-Z clamp appears in the checked B320 span; a zero Z skips its IDIV. This is a static description, not inferred from B740 or validated generally by the identity fixture.
transform_precision.fixture_limit: The identity-matrix fixture checks its chosen sample and the vertex-to-lane-to-packet association; it cannot distinguish general arithmetic order, low-WORD narrowing, or clamp behavior.

slot_102_B430.signature: void __cdecl B430(const int16_t *v0_xyz, const int16_t *v1_xyz, const int16_t *v2_xyz)
slot_102_B430.input: three pointer arguments in vertex order; each addresses 3 signed WORDs (X,Y,Z), 6 bytes per vertex

slot_107_B320.camera_xyz_lanes: Observed stores: [ESI] at B367, [ESI+0x0C] at B3A3, [ESI+0x18] at B3E1; ESI starts A8E71C and advances 4 at B403. Thus X/Y/Z signed DWORD lanes start at A8E71C/A8E728/A8E734, each with 4-byte lane stride.
slot_107_B320.screen_xy_lanes: Observed stores: [ECX+0x32] at B406 and [ECX+0x36] at B422; ECX starts A8E70E and advances 2 at B414. Thus signed WORD X/Y lanes start at A8E740/A8E746, each with 2-byte lane stride.

slot_117_B5C0.packet_xy: copies lane i to FT4 vertex i at offsets +0x08/+0x0A, +0x10/+0x12, +0x18/+0x1A

slot_101_B6F0.input: one signed WORD XYZ triplet; 6 bytes

slot_106_B920.result: signed DWORD camera XYZ plus signed WORD projected XY host globals

slot_114_B720.output: two signed WORDs (4 bytes) to caller destination

slot_121_B870.output: one WORD equal to camera Z arithmetic-shifted right two

bounded_fixture.scope: identity-matrix fixture against unchanged HERCULES.EXE callbacks only; no DLL execution, renderer, GPU, SDL, assets, or gameplay. It checks this sample and lane/packet association, not general B320/B740 arithmetic equivalence

bulk_three_record_route.association: B430 lays each pointer's signed WORD XYZ triplet at host scratch stride 6; B320 transforms input triplet i into camera/screen lane i; B5C0 pairs that lane into FT4 packet vertex slot i. The fixture confirms this with three distinct vectors under identity matrix plus Z translation. Mesh-object identity and coordinate units remain caller-specific.
